+from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
+from sqlalchemy import select
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from api.deps import get_db, get_session_id
+from api.models import Product, Wishlist, WishlistItem
+from api.schemas.wishlist import WishlistItemAdd, WishlistItemOut, WishlistOut
+
+router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/wishlist", tags=["wishlist"])
+
+
+def get_or_create_wishlist(db: Session, session_id: str) -> Wishlist:
+    wishlist = db.scalar(select(Wishlist).where(Wishlist.session_id == session_id))
+    if wishlist is None:
+        wishlist = Wishlist(session_id=session_id)
+        db.add(wishlist)
+        db.commit()
+    return wishlist
+
+
+def to_wishlist_out(wishlist: Wishlist) -> WishlistOut:
+    items = [
+        WishlistItemOut(
+            product_id=item.product_id,
+            name=item.product.name,
+            image=item.product.image,
+            price_cents=item.product.price_cents,
+        )
+        for item in wishlist.items
+    ]
+    return WishlistOut(items=items, item_count=len(items))
+
+
+@router.get("", response_model=WishlistOut)
+def get_wishlist(db: Session = Depends(get_db), session_id: str = Depends(get_session_id)):
+    return to_wishlist_out(get_or_create_wishlist(db, session_id))
+
+
+@router.post("", response_model=WishlistOut, status_code=201)
+def add_to_wishlist(
+    body: WishlistItemAdd, db: Session = Depends(get_db), session_id: str = Depends(get_session_id)
+):
+    product = db.get(Product, body.product_id)
+    if product is None:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Product not found")
+
+    wishlist = get_or_create_wishlist(db, session_id)
+    if not any(i.product_id == body.product_id for i in wishlist.items):
+        wishlist.items.append(WishlistItem(product_id=product.id))
+        db.commit()
+        db.refresh(wishlist)
+    return to_wishlist_out(wishlist)
+
+
+@router.delete("/{product_id}", response_model=WishlistOut)
+def remove_from_wishlist(
+    product_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), session_id: str = Depends(get_session_id)
+):
+    wishlist = get_or_create_wishlist(db, session_id)
+    item = next((i for i in wishlist.items if i.product_id == product_id), None)
+    if item is None:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Item not in wishlist")
+    wishlist.items.remove(item)
+    db.commit()
+    return to_wishlist_out(wishlist)

+"""Acceptance tests for REQ-001 Product Wishlist, written from the criteria and API contract."""
+from db.seed import PRODUCTS
+
+HEADPHONES = 1  # Wireless Headphones, 7999 cents
+MUG = 2  # Ceramic Coffee Mug, 1499 cents
+BACKPACK = 3  # Travel Backpack, 5999 cents
+
+
+def saved_ids(client, **kwargs):
+    return [i["product_id"] for i in client.get("/api/wishlist", **kwargs).json()["items"]]
+
+
+def test_saving_a_product_adds_it_to_the_wishlist(client):
+    response = client.post("/api/wishlist", json={"product_id": MUG})
+
+    assert response.status_code == 201
+    assert [i["product_id"] for i in response.json()["items"]] == [MUG]
+    assert saved_ids(client) == [MUG]
+
+
+def test_removing_a_saved_product_takes_it_off_the_wishlist(client):
+    client.post("/api/wishlist", json={"product_id": MUG})
+    client.post("/api/wishlist", json={"product_id": BACKPACK})
+
+    response = client.delete(f"/api/wishlist/{MUG}")
+
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert [i["product_id"] for i in response.json()["items"]] == [BACKPACK]
+    assert response.json()["item_count"] == 1
+    assert saved_ids(client) == [BACKPACK]
+
+
+def test_wishlist_lists_each_saved_product_with_name_image_and_price(client):
+    client.post("/api/wishlist", json={"product_id": HEADPHONES})
+    client.post("/api/wishlist", json={"product_id": MUG})
+
+    wishlist = client.get("/api/wishlist").json()
+
+    assert wishlist["item_count"] == 2
+    assert wishlist["items"] == [
+        {"product_id": HEADPHONES, "name": PRODUCTS[0]["name"],
+         "image": PRODUCTS[0]["image"], "price_cents": 7999},
+        {"product_id": MUG, "name": PRODUCTS[1]["name"],
+         "image": PRODUCTS[1]["image"], "price_cents": 1499},
+    ]
+
+
+def test_wishlist_items_are_in_the_order_they_were_saved(client):
+    for product_id in (BACKPACK, HEADPHONES, MUG):
+        client.post("/api/wishlist", json={"product_id": product_id})
+
+    assert saved_ids(client) == [BACKPACK, HEADPHONES, MUG]
+
+
+def test_new_shopper_has_an_empty_wishlist(client):
+    response = client.get("/api/wishlist")
+
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == {"items": [], "item_count": 0}
+
+
+def test_removing_the_last_product_leaves_an_empty_wishlist(client):
+    client.post("/api/wishlist", json={"product_id": MUG})
+
+    client.delete(f"/api/wishlist/{MUG}")
+
+    assert client.get("/api/wishlist").json() == {"items": [], "item_count": 0}
+
+
+def test_saved_product_is_still_saved_on_later_requests(client):
+    client.post("/api/wishlist", json={"product_id": MUG})
+    client.get("/api/products")
+    client.get("/api/cart")
+
+    assert saved_ids(client) == [MUG]
+    assert saved_ids(client) == [MUG]
+
+
+def test_one_session_saving_does_not_affect_another_session(client):
+    client.post("/api/wishlist", json={"product_id": MUG})
+
+    assert saved_ids(client, headers={"X-Session-Id": "another-shopper"}) == []
+    assert saved_ids(client) == [MUG]
+
+
+def test_one_session_removing_does_not_affect_another_session(client):
+    client.post("/api/wishlist", json={"product_id": MUG})
+    other = {"X-Session-Id": "another-shopper"}
+    client.post("/api/wishlist", json={"product_id": MUG}, headers=other)
+
+    client.delete(f"/api/wishlist/{MUG}", headers=other)
+
+    assert saved_ids(client) == [MUG]
+    assert saved_ids(client, headers=other) == []
+
+
+def test_saving_a_product_twice_lists_it_only_once(client):
+    client.post("/api/wishlist", json={"product_id": MUG})
+    response = client.post("/api/wishlist", json={"product_id": MUG})
+
+    assert response.status_code == 201
+    assert response.json()["item_count"] == 1
+    assert saved_ids(client) == [MUG]
+
+
+def test_saving_an_unknown_product_returns_404(client):
+    response = client.post("/api/wishlist", json={"product_id": 999})
+
+    assert response.status_code == 404
+    assert response.json() == {"detail": "Product not found"}
+    assert saved_ids(client) == []
+
+
+def test_saving_with_invalid_body_returns_422(client):
+    assert client.post("/api/wishlist", json={}).status_code == 422
+    assert client.post("/api/wishlist", json={"product_id": "abc"}).status_code == 422
+
+
+def test_removing_a_product_not_in_wishlist_returns_404(client):
+    client.post("/api/wishlist", json={"product_id": MUG})
+
+    response = client.delete(f"/api/wishlist/{BACKPACK}")
+
+    assert response.status_code == 404
+    assert response.json() == {"detail": "Item not in wishlist"}
+    assert saved_ids(client) == [MUG]
+
+
+def test_removing_twice_returns_404_the_second_time(client):
+    client.post("/api/wishlist", json={"product_id": MUG})
+    client.delete(f"/api/wishlist/{MUG}")
+
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/wishlist/{MUG}").status_code == 404
+
+
+def test_invalid_session_id_returns_422(client):
+    response = client.get("/api/wishlist", headers={"X-Session-Id": "x" * 65})
+
+    assert response.status_code == 422

+// Each test runs in a fresh browser context, so it gets its own session id and an empty wishlist.
+const { test, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
+
+test('a shopper can save products to the wishlist and remove them', async ({ page, browser }) => {
+  // Empty wishlist, opened from the header link
+  await page.goto('/');
+  await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Wishlist' }).click();
+  await expect(page.getByText('Your wishlist is empty.')).toBeVisible();
+  await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Browse products' }).click();
+  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'All products' })).toBeVisible();
+
+  // Save from the product list, without opening the product
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save Travel Backpack to wishlist' }).click();
+  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Remove Travel Backpack from wishlist' })).toHaveAttribute(
+    'aria-pressed',
+    'true',
+  );
+  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'All products' })).toBeVisible();
+
+  // Save from the product page
+  await page.goto('/products/2');
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save Ceramic Coffee Mug to wishlist' }).click();
+  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Remove Ceramic Coffee Mug from wishlist' })).toHaveAttribute(
+    'aria-pressed',
+    'true',
+  );
+
+  // Saving again through the API does not duplicate it
+  const sessionId = await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem('cornerShopSessionId'));
+  const response = await page.request.post('/api/wishlist', {
+    headers: { 'X-Session-Id': sessionId },
+    data: { product_id: 2 },
+  });
+  expect(response.status()).toBe(201);
+
+  // Still saved after a reload
+  await page.reload();
+  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Remove Ceramic Coffee Mug from wishlist' })).toHaveAttribute(
+    'aria-pressed',
+    'true',
+  );
+  await page.goto('/');
+  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Remove Travel Backpack from wishlist' })).toBeVisible();
+
+  // The Wishlist page lists each product once, with name, image, price and a link
+  await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Wishlist' }).click();
+  const rows = page.getByTestId('wishlist-item');
+  await expect(rows).toHaveCount(2);
+  await expect(rows.nth(0)).toContainText('🎒');
+  await expect(rows.nth(0)).toContainText('$59.99');
+  await expect(rows.nth(1)).toContainText('Ceramic Coffee Mug');
+
+  // Another shopper's session does not see these products
+  const otherContext = await browser.newContext();
+  const otherPage = await otherContext.newPage();
+  await otherPage.goto('/wishlist');
+  await expect(otherPage.getByText('Your wishlist is empty.')).toBeVisible();
+  await otherContext.close();
+
+  // Unsave with the filled heart on the product list
+  await page.goto('/');
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Remove Travel Backpack from wishlist' }).click();
+  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save Travel Backpack to wishlist' })).toHaveAttribute(
+    'aria-pressed',
+    'false',
+  );
+
+  // Open the remaining product from the Wishlist page, then remove it there
+  await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Wishlist' }).click();
+  await expect(rows).toHaveCount(1);
+  await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Ceramic Coffee Mug' }).click();
+  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Ceramic Coffee Mug' })).toBeVisible();
+  await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Wishlist' }).click();
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Remove Ceramic Coffee Mug from wishlist' }).click();
+  await expect(page.getByText('Your wishlist is empty.')).toBeVisible();
+});

+import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
+import * as api from './api';
+
+const EMPTY_WISHLIST = { items: [], item_count: 0 };
+
+const WishlistContext = createContext(null);
+
+// Holds the shopper's wishlist so every heart button and the Wishlist page stay in sync.
+export function WishlistProvider({ children }) {
+  const [wishlist, setWishlist] = useState(EMPTY_WISHLIST);
+  // Products with a request in flight, so a quick double click does not save and unsave at once.
+  const pending = useRef(new Set());
+
+  const refresh = useCallback(
+    () =>
+      Promise.resolve()
+        .then(() => api.getWishlist())
+        .then((w) => setWishlist(w ?? EMPTY_WISHLIST))
+        .catch(() => setWishlist(EMPTY_WISHLIST)),
+    [],
+  );
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    refresh();
+  }, [refresh]);
+
+  const addItem = async (productId) => setWishlist(await api.addToWishlist(productId));
+  const removeItem = async (productId) => setWishlist(await api.removeFromWishlist(productId));
+  const isSaved = (productId) => wishlist.items.some((item) => item.product_id === productId);
+
+  const toggle = async (productId) => {
+    if (pending.current.has(productId)) return;
+    pending.current.add(productId);
+    try {
+      await (isSaved(productId) ? removeItem(productId) : addItem(productId));
+    } finally {
+      pending.current.delete(productId);
+    }

The wishlist UI is built and every test passes: 16 unit tests and 5 end-to-end tests, including the 4 existing shop tests.

**What a shopper sees**
- **Header:** a new "Wishlist" link, placed between Products and Cart.
- **Product list:** each card has a heart in the top-right corner. Clicking it saves or unsaves the product without opening the product page, and the heart fills in when saved.
- **Product page:** the same heart sits next to "Add to cart".
- **Wishlist page:** lists each saved product with its image, its name (which links to the product page), its price and a Remove button. When the list is empty it says "Your wishlist is empty." with a "Browse products" link back to the list.

**Choices worth knowing about**
- **Double clicks:** while a save or unsave is still in progress, more clicks on that heart are ignored, so a fast double click doesn't save and then immediately unsave.
- **Duplicate saves:** a heart can only toggle, so a repeated click can't test this. The end-to-end test instead sends a second save request straight to the API, then checks the product appears only once on the Wishlist page.
- **Card structure:** the product card is now a box holding a link plus the heart button, rather than one big link, so the button isn't nested inside a link.
- **Test helper:** `renderPage()` now also wraps pages in the wishlist provider and includes a placeholder product page. The unit tests use it to check that clicking a card's heart doesn't open the product.

**Tests**
- **Unit tests:** a new `Wishlist.test.jsx` (empty state, listed items with links, removing). I added heart tests to `ProductList.test.jsx` and `ProductDetail.test.jsx`, and an empty-wishlist mock to the Cart and Checkout tests.
- **End-to-end:** `e2e/tests/wishlist.spec.js` is one test of the whole journey against the real API. It covers the empty state, opening the page from the header, saving from the list and from the product page, staying saved after a reload, that a second browser session doesn't see the items, and removing via the heart and via Remove.

review.summary: Clean, focused change that copies the existing cart patterns: get_or_create, to_*_out and the session dependency. All queries go through the SQLAlchemy ORM with no raw SQL. Every query is scoped to X-Session-Id, and tests show one session cannot see or change another's wishlist. The API, api.js and the tests match the contract, and every acceptance criterion is covered by API, Vitest or Playwright tests. I found a few minor robustness and polish points but no blockers.

findings.finding: The idempotent add is check-then-insert. If two POSTs for the same product arrive at the same moment, the second hits the UniqueConstraint and returns a 500 instead of 201. Catch IntegrityError, roll back and return the wishlist.
There is no loading state. The context starts as EMPTY_WISHLIST, so on a direct load of /wishlist a shopper with saved items briefly sees 'Your wishlist is empty.' until the GET returns.

No caller outside the provider uses 'refresh', yet the context still exposes it. The Promise.resolve().then(...) wrapper adds nothing over calling api.getWishlist() directly. Errors from toggle and remove are swallowed silently, so the shopper gets no feedback when one fails.

The contract lists 400 for a missing or invalid X-Session-Id, but get_session_id actually returns 422, and the test asserts 422. The contract defers to the existing behaviour, so this is fine, but the contract text should be corrected.
The card changed from a Link to a div wrapping a Link, so the heart button is no longer nested inside an anchor. This is a sensible fix for valid HTML and accessibility.

Corner Shop 1.1.0 (2026-10-18): Product Wishlist (REQ-001)

Shoppers can now save products they like. A heart button on each product card and on the product page saves or unsaves a product without leaving the page. A new Wishlist page, linked from the header, lists saved products in the order they were added, and shoppers can remove products from it. The wishlist lasts for the current browser session.

Technical: new API endpoints GET /api/wishlist, POST /api/wishlist (idempotent; 404 for an unknown product) and DELETE /api/wishlist/{product_id} (404 if the product is not in the wishlist). New tables wishlists and wishlist_items (Alembic migration 0002). Heart buttons ignore extra clicks while a save or unsave is in progress.

Testing: 27 API tests, 16 frontend unit tests and 5 e2e tests pass. Migration upgrade and downgrade were checked.
